language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi there, my name is Aggie. I live in a cottage near Loch Ness in Scotland. My cat Maddie here, loves to walk with me along the shore and up the hills.
Loch Ness can be a spooky place, lots of mysterious shadows. I've spent some time looking at shadows, and I'll teach you what I know.
Shadow is an area direct light from a light source is blocked due to an object. You can see the dark shape behind Maddie: that's a shadow!
Let's go for a walk so you can do some experiments with shadows.
I can help you with the activities, just click on me!

exercises.title: Which objects cast a dark shadow?

dialog.text: I’m playing hide and seek with Maddie. She wants to hide in shadows, but not all objects can cast a dark enough shadow. The object needs to be solid to block the light and create a dark shadow.
Translucent objects are a bit see-through, and cast a faint shadow. Transparent objects don’t cast any shadow at all. Which of these objects can cast a dark shadow?

exercises.title: When can we see a shadow?

dialog.text: For shadows to exist, they need enough light and the correct angle. Maddie and I are trying to find Nessie, the Loch Monster, by looking for her shadow, but sometimes there isn't a shadow to see.
Which of these conditions would let us see Nessie's shadow? Click the green button if Nessie has a shadow!

helperSimple.text: For shadows to exist, they need enough light and the correct angle. Help Aggie and Maddie find Nessie. Click on the green button if you think they can find Nessie under the condition shown. Click on the red button if you think they can't.
